component: Calendar attachment-list data and connection contract

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: After connection creates its template, setAttachments replaces all child items with mapped AttachmentStub values. URI supplies both the label and URL, while a missing icon becomes empty. The test directly checks item attributes and clearing with an empty array. This component does not load an event or wire the overview expansion; those parent phases are separate. The documented connection precondition matters because the list element must exist.
title: The Calendar attachment list replaces connected rows from URI stubs
